reference_spoken: Lamentations, chapter three, verses twenty-two and twenty-three.
verse: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verse_spoken: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness.
prayer: Heavenly Father, thank you for this new day.
Thank you that your mercies did not run out overnight.
Whatever yesterday held, the mistakes, the worries, the things left undone, you meet me this morning with fresh compassion.
Lord, I place this day in your hands.
Guide my steps, guard my words, and steady my heart when the pressure comes.
Where I feel weak, be my strength. Where I feel anxious, fill me with your peace.
Help me show others the same mercy you have shown to me.
Bless my family, bless my work, and bless everyone watching this today.
Let your faithfulness be the song of my life.
